exposure: Location of death (delivery room or neonatal intensive care unit)
Diagnosis of a major congenital anomaly
outcome: Reasons for redirection of care (inevitable death, severe compromise of expected quality of life)
Type of redirection of care (withholding or withdrawal of therapies)
cohort: Neonates who died in the delivery room or in the neonatal intensive care unit in 97 hospitals in Argentina over a 6-month period.
finding: Most neonates who die in Argentina do so while receiving full support, with redirection of care mainly occurring due to a condition of inevitable death.
